title: Screen P112 tetrad coefficient fusion under relaxed rank ceilings
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

This update adds an exact hybrid consumer for the selected P112 tetrad basis changes. Each `U K` has four zero rows. Let `H` keep the old cut on those rows and use `(U^-T S)` on the four updated rows; let `C` be zero on the first four rows and `S-H` on the last four. Exact rational checks give `H^T d + C^T d = S^T d` and `H^T U K = S^T K`.

Across fourteen blocks, `H` has 225 nonzero coefficients and the bottom-only correction has 152. That is 201 net extra incidences over the original 176-add cut, versus 391 for the full separate-dirty correction. Under the existing rank-72 ideal and hypothetical one-rank-1-unit-per-net-incidence screen, three blocks give a complex-only ceiling of `0.004947467105`; fourteen give `0.033708626028`. These are planning sensitivities, not a scalar tariff, admitted supplier, or achieved κ.

The source-bound forward program places all 176 cut additions at events 12554–12757, before phase B starts at 12759. The exact native coefficients match the canonical cut. B adds to all 112 output ports and does not touch the eight centre carriers. In the canonical scalar projection, `precondition + compensation + A` maps the initial dirty output block through an invertible 272-entry response (determinant `2^-56`); adapter calls are not expanded by that matrix check. The hybrid map is therefore not integrated into the selected cut chronology, and its endpoint semantics remain open. The previously checked selected κ remains `0.001672660197076918`; no κ improvement or frontier update is claimed.

## Task and overlap

Task card `coverage-law-change`, priority revision 6; scope refined to the source-bound P112 consumer and its selected chronology. The package base is `b1ef0a5585418590320806c967383584c645132b`; submission-refresh canonical `main` is `20ecf2891d80b5acf18d980b2164fb44ea7faa90`, with priority revision 6 and selected-result SHA-256 `bb2eaa58647b353f88d0aec2eafb9d30df1be53589231b23e12ceef3e4bad129`.

Adjacent [PR #3344](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3344) screens larger-child and multiple-unpaid budgets; [PR #3566](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3566) binds the selected-port bijection and term ranks; [PR #3567](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/3567) bounds a one-sided tetrad alphabet's effective rank and term cap. None checks this hybrid consumer against the selected cut chronology. The overlap helper's cached snapshot covered 394 open PRs and 2,319 discussions at 2026-10-18 03:15 UTC, but its live API refresh failed. I also checked the current adjacent PR pages and the handoff/proposal discussions; this is not a novelty certificate.

## Validation

Replayed with CPython 3.12.15:

```sh
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-tetrad-cut-consumer --check-only
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-tetrad-cut-consumer
python3.12 -O -B research/p112-tetrad-cut-consumer/verify.py
git diff --check
```

The verifier binds the selected archive and local-program hashes, checks all 176 native cut coefficients and their position before B, reconstructs all fourteen source-bound tetrads, verifies the full and hybrid identities and correction supports, and reports the rank-72 sensitivities. No full selected cold replay, adapter expansion, bit-side supplier, scalar incidence tariff, or complete outer invoice is claimed.

## Credit

The P112 geometry, port bijection, selected gauge44 word, and bit-side price engine retain the attribution in their predecessor packages. This follow-up adds the hybrid consumer identities, exact support counts, sensitivity screen, and chronology audit. Prepared by Gonzalo Mier with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

1. What adapter-expanded update reaches the pre-B cut, and can a post-B hybrid reader preserve the selected endpoint? Bind one tetrad through adapters, B, cleanup, and the exact dirty-output obligation.
2. Once the consumer contract is fixed, can another unimodular completion lower the cut and correction supports without changing the fused term cost?
3. Can a concrete scalar tariff, admitted complex supplier, and bit-side supplier keep the joint target above `0.003`? Replace the rank-72 and incidence assumptions with a complete source-bound invoice.
